title: Alignment runbook — roadmap convergence lab (scratch)
text:
Alignment runbook — roadmap convergence lab (scratch)

Purpose / framing:
- Quick scratchpad to prep the cross-functional roadmap sync (product + eng + applied ML).
- Outcome we want: 3 concrete decisions + clear owners + timeline for the next 8 weeks.
- Keep it pragmatic: surface only blockers that change scope or timing.

Meeting context & constraints:
- Audience: PMs (product-hosted-api), infra leads (serving-runtime, platform-eng), applied ML research owners.
- We have an upcoming Dedicated capacity procurement window (end of month) that affects which features we can guarantee in Q3.
- Budget signal: finance has flagged 15% uplift cap for GPU spend this quarter unless we can show unit-cost improvement.

Pre-reads (send before meeting):
1) Lightweight cost delta doc (Ravi) — link in chat.
2) Short eval summary: latency vs quality for quantized variants (Samir) — 2-slide pdf.
3) Draft rollout policy proposal (Elena) — Confluence page.

Agenda (45 min total) — tight timeboxing
- 0–5m: Quick framing + success criteria (me)
- 5–15m: Product priorities & customer commitments (Ravi) — which features are must-ships vs nice-to-have
- 15–30m: Technical constraints + perf/cost tradeoffs (Samir + infra) — highlight blockers to deliverable timelines
- 30–40m: Gate/rollout plan & evals (Elena) — how we prevent regressions + metric buckets
- 40–45m: Decisions, owners, next steps (wrap)

Key topics / talking points (notes to self)
- Model pinning: Product wants M3-like family pinned for hosted API. Applied ML says that quantized 4-bit variant reduces cost by ~35% with minimal quality loss on our eval set, but unknown tail failure modes.
  - My ask: get an experimental canary on dedicated pool for 2 weeks before pin.
  - Risk: if canary reveals hallucination spike, product may need quick fallback path.

- Autoscale & burst policy: platform team plans to cap burst to x2 baseline for Dedicated to avoid runaway spend. Product needs sustained burst for load spikes (sales demos).
  - Trade: allow short (2–5 min) higher bursts with explicit guardrails and metering.
  - TODO: define exact burst budget (SLO vs cost tradeoff).

- Eval gating: applied ML proposes adding two new prompt sets that mimic power-users (enterprise prompts). Need to run continuous eval against both hosted and dedicated stacks.
  - Action: Elena to produce eval spec + baseline thresholds.
  - Question: where to store eval artifacts (Confluence vs S3?). Prefer S3 + single Confluence link to manifest.

- Observability gaps: Console currently shows token-level cost and latency, but not per-route quality drift. Product wants quick alerts for quality regressions tied to prompt set.
  - Minimal first step: add a per-route periodic eval job (nightly) and a slack alert when top-5 prompt set MRR drops > 5%.
  - Owner: eng-observability + applied-ml.

Decision checklist (what I'm trying to lock in during sync)
- Decision A: Approve a 2-week canary of quantized model variant on a dedicated pool (yes/no).
- Decision B: Temporary burst policy: allow 3x burst for up to 5 minutes for demo traffic with explicit budget tagging (yes/no).
- Decision C: Mandate eval gating for any model pin change with a defined baseline and rollback criteria (yes/no).

Open questions to surface early
- If canary fails quality checks mid-run, what's the rollback SLA? Who triggers? (PM or infra?)
- Do we have SLOs that tie to customer-facing latency for hosted API that would forbid aggressive batching?
- How many prompt examples per route are sufficient for nightly eval? (10 vs 50)

Draft action items (post-meeting — will convert to Jira tickets)
- AI-1: Elena — write eval spec + manifest and push to S3 (due 2026-05-25)
- AI-2: Samir — run cost/latency microbench (3 sequence lengths) for quantized variants and share CSV (due 2026-05-20)
- AI-3: Ravi — confirm customer commitments that require pin by end of Q2 and list 3 customers impacted (due 2026-05-22)
- AI-4: Platform (TBD: Jason) — draft burst policy config and emergency abort flow (due 2026-05-24)
- AI-5: Observability (Priya) + Applied ML (Samir) — prototype nightly per-route eval job and Slack alert (POC) (due 2026-05-28)

Notes-to-self (informal / scratch)
- Keep language non-technical when explaining tradeoffs to product stakeholders — focus on customer impact and rollback safety.
- Bring two concrete numbers for burst policy: cost cap (USD/hr) and max concurrent tokens.
- Confirm where billing tags will be set for canary runs (customer vs experiment).

Meeting logistics
- Proposed time: 2026-05-18 10:00–10:45 PT (confirm with Ravi + Samir)
- Zoom link: use team meeting room Zoom (copy from calendar template)
- Pre-reads sent by EOD 2026-05-17 — Slack reminder morning of meeting

Follow-up format (what I will send after meeting)
- Short email: 3 decisions, owners, deadlines (bullet list).
- Add action items to Jira, link Confluence eval manifest.
- Quick 15-minute follow-up in two weeks to validate canary telemetry.

Scratch / brainstorming (random)
- Could we run canary on a lower-cost region for cost experiments while keeping production region unchanged? Pros: cheaper. Cons: different infra perf.
- Consider short-term 'safety net' model: keep full-precision variant hot as fallback for first 48 hours. Need orchestration change.

Rough timeline sketch (for my notes)
- Week 0 (this week): Approvals + eval spec + cost microbench
- Week 1: Canary deploy quantized variant to dedicated pool (2 weeks run)
- Week 3: Analyze canary -> decide pin / rollback -> if pin, schedule hosted rollout with throttled ramp
- Week 5–8: Monitor, iterate, complete documentation + customer comms

End scratch — leave plenty of white space during meeting to capture decisions verbatim.
